description: This file defines a Java interface for a repository handling MaintenanceLog entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository and providing a custom query method to find maintenance logs by vehicle.

classes.name: MaintenanceLogRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for MaintenanceLog entities, providing CRUD operations and a custom method to find logs by vehicle.

methods.name: findByVehicle
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MaintenanceLog entries associated with a specific Vehicle.
